projects.title: Biometric Data Tracking
projects.description:
Developed a robust application designed to assist psychiatrists in monitoring client biometric data and identifying significant behavioral patterns. The system integrates a machine learning model built with TensorFlow and Python to detect anomalous activity, enabling real-time alerts for prompt interventions.

Key Features:

Data Visualization: Created an intuitive user interface using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) to allow easy analysis and tracking of biometric trends.

Machine Learning Integration: Implemented a predictive model to flag potential emotional spikes, offering early insights for mental health management.

Real-Time Monitoring: Enabled real-time alerts via push notifications, empowering psychiatrists to respond effectively to critical events.

projects.title: NFL Data Combine Analysis
projects.description:
Designed and implemented a comprehensive data analysis pipeline to uncover insights from NFL Combine performance metrics. The project involved data scraping, processing, and visualizing relationships between combine results and future player success, offering valuable statistical insights for talent evaluation.

Key Features:

Data Collection and Processing: Scraped and aggregated over 5,000 lines of data from five different sources using Python libraries like BeautifulSoup and Pandas.

Data Visualization: Created 30 graphs and infographics using Matplotlib to illustrate correlations between combine metrics and NFL success.

Insights and Findings: Identified six measurable relationships between performance metrics and success, with R² values below 0.35, highlighting the challenges of predictive modeling in sports analytics.
